children: Data compiled from HKEX Disclosure Easy's Shanghai-Hong Kong Stock Connect and Shenzhen-Hong Kong Stock Connect shareholding records showed that on the previous day, with holding date September 7, 2026, the largest increase in holdings was in Southern Hang Seng Tech (3033), which rose by 115 million shares, while the biggest reduction was in BRILLIANCE CHI (1114), which fell by 26.926 million shares, according to Ming Pao.

title: Southbound Holdings Rise Most In Hang Seng Tech ETF, BRILLIANCE CHI Cut Most
